posts.title: Re-Developing Perspective
posts.description: Fifteen years ago I started a podcast called Developing Perspective. It was “never longer than 15 minutes” and chronicled my journey of becoming an indie app developer. I did that for around four years and then joined up with Marco Arment to do a show on the same topic called Under the Radar . We did that together for 10 years before bringing it to a close. posts.title: Apple-like
posts.description: In the last few months there has been a lot of discussion of people’s hopes for the future of Apple. posts.title: Six Years Perfecting Maps on watchOS
posts.description: I love going on wilderness adventures. I am rarely happier than when I am far off into the mountains without a soul in sight. As a result, I have spent a lot of time learning how to safely explore and navigate when I’m away from civilization.
